note: Free Eldorado NF campground on a forested peninsula on the northwest shore of Union Valley Reservoir, reached by a rough dirt road. No water, grills or tables; fire rings only. --Claude
summary: Camino Cove (Eldorado NF): FS page + Eldorado ROG PDF + rec.gov search + Esri + 3DEP. Operating, off season now. Free, first-come, June-October, 32 units, 14-day limit, vault toilets, no water. Lakefront downgrade candidate (no site-level proof), lakeview suggested.
flags: WATERFRONT downgrade candidate: lakefront -> lakeview. The campground fills a forested peninsula ~150-190 m wide. 3DEP puts the treeline at about Union Valley's full pool (~4,870-4,871 ft) and the forest floor 1-5 m above it, so at full pool the water reaches the trees on both sides. But there is no site map, no rec.gov catalog and no visible pad under the canopy, so no named site can be placed within ~50 m of the high-water edge over open ground. The bare apron in the imagery is drawdown lakebed (4,844-4,857 ft), not an open apron above high water. Rule: a keep needs named sites, and unsure means down. A view through the open pines to the water on both sides is very likely. Suggested evidence: 'Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-26: forested peninsula, treeline = full pool (~4,870 ft), forest 1-5 m above; no site positions published -> lakeview'.
